title: [IRS Forms] Performance optimization
summary: IRS 1099 form box calculation performance improved by optimizing database queries to use more selective index keys and vendor filtering, reducing query execution time from approximately 10 minutes.
key_points: Changed SetCurrentKey in FindRelatedApplicationDetailedVendorLedgerEntries to use Application No., Vendor No., Entry Type instead of Vendor Ledger Entry No., Entry Type
Added VendorNo parameter to FilterPaymentVendorLedgerEntries to filter by specific vendor when requested
Existing keys were reused; no schema changes required
Root cause addressed by reducing unnecessary enumeration of payment history across all vendors
quote: Aligning the current key with those equality filters lets the optimizer satisfy the ordering with a selective index seek instead of a broad scan.
